retainedBaselineSources.relevantExcerpt: Three Cosmos Holofoil versions of the Regular print with different stamps in the bottom left corner of the artwork were given away with eligible [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] purchases at participating retailers in various countries starting March 28, 2025. Variants featuring a red {{wp|GameStop}} logo were available in-store or online from GameStop in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} with a $15 minimum purchase. Variants featuring an {{wp|EB Games}} logo were distributed in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}} with purchases worth at least $15 at EB Games stores or through their online shop.<ref>[https://www.pokemon.com/us/pokemon-news/hop-into-pokemon-tcg-scarlet-violet-journey-together-with-hops-snorlax-and-hops-dubwool ''Hop into Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—Journey Together with Hop’s Snorlax and Hop’s Dubwool'' | Pokémon.com] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20250314225915/https://www.pokemon.com/us/pokemon-news/hop-into-pokemon-tcg-scarlet-violet-journey-together-with-hops-snorlax-and-hops-dubwool archived])</ref> Variants featuring the Journey Together expansion logo were available at participating stores in {{pmin|Singapore}}, {{pmin|Malaysia}}, {{pmin|the Philippines}} with purchases worth at least S$25, RM80, and ₱1,030, respectively.<ref>[https://asia.pokemon-card.com/sg/archives/6689/ ''Scarlet & Violet — Journey Together Release Promo Card'' | Pokémon Card Game Trainers Website Singapore] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20250322123658/https://asia.pokemon-card.com/sg/archives/6689/ archived])</ref><ref>[https://asia.pokemon-card.com/my/archives/6693/ ''Scarlet & Violet — Journey Together Release Promo Card'' | Pokémon Card Game Trainers Website Malaysia] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20250307191040/https://asia.pokemon-card.com/my/archives/6693/ archived])</ref><ref>[https://asia.pokemon-card.com/ph/archives/6695/ ''Scarlet & Violet — Journey Together Release Promo Card'' | Pokémon Card Game Trainers Website Philippines] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20250322123552/https://asia.pokemon-card.com/ph/archives/6695/ archived])</ref>

March 14, 2025
Hop into Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—Journey Together with Hop’s Snorlax and Hop’s Dubwool
Get promo cards featuring Hop’s Pokémon at select retailers.
Journey to your favorite Pokémon TCG retailers to pick up promo cards featuring Hop’s Dubwool and Hop’s Snorlax. To celebrate the release of the Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—Journey Together adventure, starting March 28, 2025, and while supplies last, players in the United States who purchase $15 worth of Pokémon TCG products at Best Buy will receive a Hop’s Dubwool promo card.
Pick up $15 worth of Pokémon TCG products at GameStop to bring home a Hop’s Snorlax promo card. Australian players who purchase $15 worth of Pokémon TCG products at EB Games will receive a Hop’s Snorlax promo card.
And Canadians can buy $15 worth of Pokémon TCG products at GameStop to receive a Hop’s Snorlax promo card. Purchases can be made in-store or online.
